summary: Global Partners LP filed an 8-K announcing the full redemption of all outstanding Series B Fixed Rate Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Units (NYSE: GLP pr B) on July 30, 2026. The redemption price is $25.00 per unit plus accrued and unpaid distributions to the redemption date, payable in cash. The board approved the redemption; Equiniti Trust Company, LLC acts as redemption agent. All units will be redeemed, ceasing trading on NYSE. This capital return event returns cash to preferred holders. Watch for redemption mechanics and potential tax implications.
